title: research: classify rational four-cycle shears in the P112 fit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Classifies every rational support pair generated by four elementary shears ordered around a directed cycle on any four channels of the published PR3335 rank-34 P112 factorization. A symbolic path expansion reduces the rational coefficient space to zero-edge masks and the single full-cycle cancellation condition `x0*x1*x2*x3 = -1`; this does not classify arbitrary `GL4(Q)` gauges.

## Result

The 408 canonical parameter-cell representatives collapse to 193 distinct support pairs. Pricing all 193 maps on all 46,376 channel quadruples checks 8,950,568 cases; the minimum invoice remains 224 and no quadruple improves. In the all-nonzero cycle stratum, every quadruple costs at least one additional unit and the best invoice is 225. A dense control verifies all 12,544 scalar fitting entries for each representative and rejects a wrong inverse. No kappa or supplier change is claimed.

## Validation

- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-cycle-holonomy --check-only`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-cycle-holonomy`

The registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.15 in normal and optimized modes, including the symbolic rational support-cell proof, all exact tariff receipts, and dense identity controls.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. A refreshed text scan covered 727 open PRs and 2,593 Discussion records at 2026-10-19 09:52 UTC. Discussion #2488's paired output cycles and #1332's selected T16 helper relocation concern different objects. PR4020 and PR4022 are the exact rational pair and triple predecessors. The search does not inspect every code diff or establish novelty.

## Credit

Matarener/Mark and Claude via Claude Code supplied PR3335's rematching and rank-34 factorization. Arham Tahir's paired-plane audit and credited predecessors supply the full-plane tariff and 224 base invoice. This exact cycle-word support classification and census were prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can a four-channel word outside cycle order, such as a path with a chord, exploit a different cancellation cell? Derive its support polynomials before widening the screen. Even a tariff below 160 would only pass the optimistic copy screen; a physical decoder, dirty-state restoration and complete supplier would still be required.
